deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 for full consideration for Fall 2027; later applications are considered only if positions remain.
deadline.quote: given full consideration for admission the following August, all required application materials should be completed by December 15

fee_waiver.value: The department has few fee waivers, awarded only to exceptional students with demonstrated financial need.
fee_waiver.quote: We have a limited number of fee waivers to offer | We will only award fee waivers to exceptional students who have demonstrated financial need

gre_general.value: Both the general and the physics subject GRE are optional and can be self-reported.
gre_general.quote: neither general nor physics subject GRE scores are required for our program | Both tests are optional, and their scores can be self-reported

gre_subject.value: The physics subject GRE is optional and can be self-reported.
gre_subject.quote: neither general nor physics subject GRE scores are required for our program | Both tests are optional, and their scores can be self-reported

supervisor.value: Individual professors do not make admissions decisions, and contacting one is not needed before applying.
supervisor.quote: Individual professors do not make admissions decisions | Directly contacting a professor is not necessary to secure funding before applying to WVU

funding.value: The department aims to fund all first-year doctoral students with a TA and tuition waiver; later years depend on available TA or RA funding.
funding.quote: The department aims to provide all first-year doctoral students will receive a Teaching Assistantship (TA) and a waiver of University tuition | Subsequent years may be funded by TA duties or by an RA position

entry_route.value: Applicants to the M.S. or Ph.D. are expected to hold a bachelor's degree in physics, astronomy or a related field.
entry_route.quote: applicants to either degree program are expected to have a bachelor’s degree in physics, astronomy, or a related field

notes: Fee-waiver form ideally by November 15; decision by December 1. Admitted students who lack some upper-division courses may be asked to take them at WVU.
